_comment: Incremental mutation gate. Scope with --mutate on the CLI (changed lines in a PR). testRunner runs only tests related to each mutated file.
_ignoreStatic_comment: Static mutants run every selected test and are excluded from this advisory PR score. The last changed-line run found 84 static mutants (3%) responsible for an estimated 99% of mutation time and hit the 25-minute job limit.
_thresholds_comment: Advisory rollout: break=null never fails the process, so the CI job reports the score without blocking a PR. Once the team is comfortable, set break (e.g. 60) to make the gate enforce.
